items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff’s son walks away from a terrifying go-kart crash, demands to race tomorrow
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫之子从惊险的卡丁车事故中脱身，要求明天参赛
Jack Wolff，梅赛德斯老板托托·沃尔夫之子，在IAME战士决赛中发生了一个引人注目的事件
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
如果有人曾怀疑杰克·沃尔夫是否继承了父母——梅赛德斯一级方程式车队负责人托托·沃尔夫和一级方程式学院总经理苏西·沃尔夫——的无尽赛车精神，那么今天这些怀疑完全消除了
九岁的卡丁车天才在IAME勇士决赛（IWF26）中发生了一场巨大、可怕的撞车事故，但他并没有被吓倒，反而已经要求重新回到驾驶座上。
杰克在意大利IAME系列赛X30 U10类别中，在炎热的夏天表现出色后，最近赢得了他的第一个冠军头衔，在X30迷你决赛的最后圈中，他正与车手们激烈争夺，但事情突然变得非常糟糕。
从我们的观察来看，埃尔加胡迪和沃尔夫都领先于其他人，其他人都在争夺第三名，然后就在这时，他们的前轮锁定了。
这次接触导致卡丁车打滑，一名跟在后面的车手被猛烈地抛到了纠缠在一起的卡丁车上方。
“看那个直接飞越顶部的，是乌宗诺夫，”解说员注意到碰撞，显然非常震惊。“我不知道埃尔加胡迪怎么没有在那里翻车……还有杰克·沃尔夫，肩膀上受到了重击。”
“尾随的卡丁车直接从杰克头上飞过，落地时击中了他的肩膀。撞击看起来非常严重，尤其是对于一个九岁的车手来说。”
“幸运的是，年轻的沃尔夫凭借自己的力量从损坏的卡丁车中脱身。”
“我们希望他没事；红旗升起后，我们看到他站起来了，正在和赛事官员交谈，”广播在红旗升起后不久确认。
赛车记者托马斯·马赫在社交媒体上对事故进行了令人放心的更新。
"今天在卡丁车比赛中发生了一起令人震惊的事故，涉及托托·沃尔夫的儿子杰克，" 马赫发布。"幸运的是，他没事，尽管他在离开后需要一些轻微的治疗。
托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯-AMG F1车队的主教练和首席执行官，他的妻子苏西·沃尔夫，F1学院的总经理，以及他们的儿子杰克·沃尔夫
但接下来发生的事情真正证明了杰克对赛车的热爱。尽管肩膀受到重击并需要医疗照顾，但他完全没有退缩的打算。
“他坚决表示明天还会参加比赛，所以他在一开始就表现出了一些坚韧，”马赫透露。
对于一个九岁的孩子来说，在一场卡丁车飞过他头顶的碰撞后立刻询问何时可以再次比赛，这简直令人难以置信。虽然Toto和Susie Wolff今晚可能如释重负，但他们也必须为儿子坚韧不拔的精神感到无比自豪。
detailEn: Toto Wolff’s son walks away from a terrifying go-kart crash, demands to race tomorrow
Jack Wolff, the son of Mercedes boss Toto Wolff, was involved in an eye-opening incident during the IAME Warrior Final
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

If anyone ever doubted whether Jack Wolff inherited the relentless racing spirit of his parents - Mercedes F1 team principal Toto Wolff and F1 Academy Managing Director Susie Wolff - those doubts were completely erased today.
The nine-year-old karting prodigy was involved in a massive, scary crash during the IAME Warrior Final (IWF26), but instead of being shaken up, he is already demanding to get back behind the wheel.

Jack, who recently claimed his first championship title in the IAME Series Italy X30 U10 category after a dominant summer run, was battling at the absolute front of the pack during the X30 Mini final lap when things went terribly wrong.
From what we saw, Elgahoudi and Wolff were both clear of the rest, and everybody else was fighting for third, and then there was this moment when they just locked front wheels.
And that contact sent the karts skidding, and a trailing driver was violently launched over the top of the tangled karts.

"Look at that straight over the top there went... went Uzunov," the commentator noted, clearly shocked by the impact. "How Elgahoudi did not flip there, I do not know... and Jack Wolff as well, taking a big hit to the shoulder."
The trailing kart flew directly over Jack's head, striking his shoulder as it landed. The impact looked incredibly severe, especially for a nine-year-old driver.
Fortunately, the young Wolff managed to extract himself from the wrecked kart under his own power.
"We do hope he's OK; we've seen him on his feet and talking to the race officials," the broadcast confirmed shortly after the red flags flew.
Motorsport journalist Thomas Maher provided a reassuring update on social media following the incident.
"Eye-opening crash in karting involving Toto Wolff's son, Jack, today," Maher posted. "Thankfully, he's fine, although he did need some minor treatment after walking away."
Toto Wolff, Team Principal and CEO, Mercedes-AMG F1 Team, wife Susie Wolff, Managing Director of F1 Academy, with son Jack Wolff
But what happened next truly proves that Jack has racing in his blood. Despite taking a heavy hit to the shoulder and requiring medical attention, he has absolutely no intention of backing down.
"He's adamant he's racing again tomorrow, so he's showing some early tenacity," Maher revealed.

For a nine-year-old kid to walk away from a crash where a kart flew over his head and immediately ask when he can race again is nothing short of incredible. While Toto and Susie Wolff are likely breathing a massive sigh of relief tonight, they also have to be incredibly proud of their son's toughness.

detailEn: United States GP: Charles Leclerc fastest in upgraded Ferrari in first practice in Austin as Mercedes rivals introduce updates
Watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Ted Kravitz talks through Ferrari's fourth and final upgrades for the United States Grand Prix.
Charles Leclerc showed early promise in an upgraded Ferrari car to pip Red Bull's in-form Max Verstappen to the fastest time of first practice at the United States Grand Prix.

Ferrari, McLaren and Red Bull all introduced fresh revisions to their cars for the opening hour of running at the Circuit of the Americas, which is staging the first leg of the sport's second of three end-of-season triple headers.

Ferrari's package features changes to their car's floor, sidepod and diffuser and showed speed on both the medium and soft tyres around the undulating COTA lap, with Leclerc ultimately setting the session's pace on the latter with a best lap of 1:36.052.

Verstappen, the winner of the last two races, finished 0.084s behind Leclerc although lost a lap which was two tenths faster than the Ferrari due to a track limits violation at Turn 19.

Lando Norris was third in a McLaren car which also features changes as they bid to return to form after a difficult run of races saw them slip into the clutches of Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship battle for third.

World championship leaders Mercedes do not have fresh upgrades in Austin. But both of their drivers are back to running the package first introduced two races ago in Malaysia after George Russell reverted to the older-spec last time out in Singapore.

Russell finished fourth, 0.326s behind, in opening practice with title-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli fifth on a weekend the Italian could clinch 2026's world title if he wins on Sunday and his team-mate and Lewis Hamilton do not score sufficient points to stay in mathematical contention.

items.titleZh: 美国大奖赛三车手受罚
items.summaryZh: 至少三名车手因超过动力单元组件配额而在美国大奖赛中受到发车位置处罚。半数车手在本赛季已超过至少一个引擎组件配额，现在增至22名车手中的12名。
items.originalTitle: Three drivers get grid penalties at F1's US GP
detailZh: 至少三名车手将因超过动力单元组件配额而在一级方程式美国大奖赛中受到发车位置处罚。
本赛季已有半数车手超过至少一个引擎组件配额，现在增至在奥斯汀的22名车手中的12名。
奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托已经使用了第四个引擎储存和第四个控制电子单元，超过了这两个项目的三组件限制，从而触发20位发车位置处罚。
博尔特洛托还更换了新的内燃机、涡轮增压器、排气系统和动力单元辅助组件，但这些都在他的配额内。
阿维德·林德布拉德因为今年使用了第六个内燃机单元，而允许的只有四个，因此他被处以五位的发车网格罚分。第一次超过限制的组件会得到十位的发车网格罚分，但之后的每次都会增加五位。
弗朗科·科拉平托今年使用了第四个控制电子单元，这意味着他在美国大奖赛上将被处以十位的发车网格罚分。
detailEn: At least three drivers will take grid penalties at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix for exceeding their power unit component allowance.
Half the grid had already exceeded at least one engine component allowance this season, but that's now risen to 12 of the 22 drivers at Austin.
Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto has taken a fourth engine store and a fourth control electronics unit of the year, exceeding the three-component limit for both and triggering a 20-place grid penalty.
Bortoleto also has a new internal combustion engine, turbocharger, exhaust and power unit ancillary component, but all of those are within his allowance.

Arvid Lindblad has a five-place grid penalty for taking his sixth internal combustion unit of the year, when four are allowed. You get a 10-place grid penalty for the first component over the limit, but five places thereafter.
Franco Colapinto has a fourth control electronics unit of the year, meaning he has a 10-place grid penalty at the US GP.
keyPointsZh: 博尔特洛托因超过三组件限制而受到20位发车位置处罚
keyPointsEn: Bortoleto receives a 20-place grid penalty for exceeding the three-component limit

items.originalTitle: Liam Lawson shares throwback video before first live performance in over a decade
detailZh: 劳森在首次超过十年的现场表演前分享了怀旧视频
小红牛车手劳森与他的兄弟和童年朋友们重聚，为他首次现场音乐表演助阵
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
劳森不仅仅是在奥斯汀驾驶小红牛赛车来参加比赛，你知道吗？在周四，他还进行了十多年来的首次现场音乐表演。在演出前，他发布了一段自己与兄弟和童年朋友们一起演奏的怀旧视频。
这篇帖子在撰写时已经获得了87,000个赞和超过370条评论，粉丝们兴奋地期待着在美洲赛车场的比赛周末看到这位新西兰车手。
劳森在周四晚上美国大奖赛之前来到了Esses Bazaar的舞台，与他的兄弟马库斯和童年好友托马斯和哈里森重逢。这是他自11岁以来第一次在人群中表演。
“我11岁时曾在人群中表演，那也是我最后一次这样做。已经很久了，”他在表演前对《人物》杂志说。
劳森和他的兄弟在父亲引导下一起在新西兰长大，一起弹奏音乐。
“音乐一直伴随着我的生活和家人的生活，自从我非常小的时候起，”劳森继续说道。 “他让我和我的兄弟从小就接触吉他。我们基本上是一起长大的。”
他补充说，他为了吉他考试学习了七年，甚至在孩提时代就写了自己的歌曲。尽管如此，他现在并没有打算开始写歌。
“和我的兄弟还有我从小一起玩的朋友们一起做这件事是个很酷的机会，”劳森对媒体说。 “说实话，我们大概有十年没做过这样的事情了。”
这次表演吸引了许多一级方程式明星，丹尼尔·里卡多、伊萨克·哈贾尔和阿维德·林德布拉德都出现在东第六街的Inn Cahoots。”
劳森在定制的泰勒吉他上演奏了一首乡村风格的经典曲目。
小红牛后来称这是一场“充满音乐和朋友的难忘之夜”。
劳森在即将到来的美洲赛车场的比赛中，以75分位列车手锦标赛第九位。
detailEn: Liam Lawson shares throwback video before first live performance in over a decade
Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson reunited with his brother and childhood friends for his first live music performance
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Liam Lawson isn't just in Austin to race behind the wheel of a Racing Bulls car, you know? On Thursday, he also played his first live music gig in over a decade. Before the show, he posted a throwback clip of himself playing beside his brother and childhood friends.
The post had passed 87,000 likes and more than 370 comments at the time of writing, with fans excited to see the Kiwi over the race weekend at Circuit of the Americas.

Lawson took to the stage at the Esses Bazaar on Thursday night ahead of the United States Grand Prix, reuniting with his brother Marcus and childhood friends Thomas and Harrison. It was the first time he had played in front of a crowd since he was 11.
“I played in front of a crowd when I was 11, and that was the last time I did it. It’s been a long time,” he told People before the show.
The group grew up playing music together in New Zealand, after Lawson’s father got both of his sons into playing the guitar.
“Music’s been in my life and my family’s life since I was very, very young,” Lawson continued. “He got me and my brother into guitar when we were very young. We grew up basically playing together.”
He added that he had studied for guitar exams for seven years, and even wrote his own songs as a child. He doesn't have plans to start writing now, though.
“It’s a cool opportunity to do this with my brother and a couple of friends that I’ve grown up playing with,” Lawson told the media. “To be honest, we haven’t done this for like 10 years.”
The performance drew a strong turnout of Formula 1 stars, with Daniel Ricciardo, Isack Hadjar and Arvid Lindblad all in the crowd at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street.
Lawson played a mostly country set of covers on a signature Taylor guitar made for him.
Racing Bulls later called it “an unforgettable evening filled with music and friends”.
Lawson is ninth in the drivers’ championship on 75 points heading into this weekend’s race at the Circuit of the Americas.

items.originalTitle: Fans lose it as Daniel Ricciardo spotted supporting Liam Lawson at Austin live performance
detailZh: 粉丝们在奥斯汀现场表演中看到丹尼尔·里卡多支持利亚姆·劳森时情绪失控
小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森在美国大奖赛前夕在奥斯汀登台进行罕见的现场音乐表演
丹尼尔·里卡多，Visa Cash App 小红牛 F1车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
利亚姆·劳森在周四晚上在奥斯汀的舞台上看到了一些熟悉的面孔。
这位新西兰人在Esses Bazaar ATX的Garage 各节练习与排位 with 劳森 and Friends上担任主角，这是在美国大奖赛周末之前在东第六街的Inn Cahoots举行的。
劳森在2024年取代了丹尼尔·里卡多在小红牛的位置，里卡多在那里观看，还有他现在的队友阿维德·林德布拉德和前队友伊萨克·哈吉尔也在场。
劳森与他的兄弟马库斯以及两个童年好友托马斯和哈里森一起表演，这是他自11岁以来第一次公开表演。
“我有很多感受。我的意思是，我对……能和我的兄弟还有几个从小一起玩的朋友一起做这件事感到很兴奋，”这位24岁的年轻人告诉在奥斯汀表演前的媒体。
“说实话，我们大概有10年没做过这样的事情了。显然，我们从未真正表演过，但我们很小的时候就一起长大了。所以这是一个很酷的机会。但当然，我紧张得要命。”
当被问及现场表演的压力是否比大奖赛更大时，劳森补充说：“哦我的天，比这多10倍的压力。我宁愿坐进一辆一级方程式赛车去Q3，也不愿做这件事。”
小红牛在社交媒体上分享了劳森和里卡多在活动中的照片，以及表演的几个视频。一位粉丝评论道：“小红牛给了人们他们想要的东西，”另一位补充说：“澳大利亚和新西兰喜欢看到这一切。”
“哦我的天哪，我对这件事（我100%在尖叫）完全冷静和沉着，”另一位粉丝发布了一条帖子。
美国大奖赛将于10月25日在美洲赛道举行。
detailEn: Fans lose it as Daniel Ricciardo spotted supporting Liam Lawson at Austin live performance
Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson took to the stage for a rare live music performance in Austin ahead of the United States Grand Prix
Daniel Ricciardo, Visa Cash App RB F1 Team
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Liam Lawson had some familiar faces in the crowd as he took to the stage in Austin on Thursday night.
The New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends at part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.
Daniel Ricciardo, who Lawson replaced at Racing Bulls in 2024, was there to watch along with current team-mate Arvid Lindblad and former team-mate Isack Hadjar.
Lawson performed alongside his brother Marcus and two childhood friends, Thomas and Harrison, in what was his first public performance since he was 11.

"I am feeling a lot of things. I mean, I'm excited for... It's a cool opportunity to do this with my brother and a couple of friends that I've grown up playing with," the 24-year-old told the media in Austin ahead of the performance.

"To be honest, we haven't done this for like 10 years. And obviously, we never really performed, but we grew up playing together when we were very young. So it's a cool opportunity. But no, I'm sh***ing myself, for sure."

When asked if there was more pressure for the live performance than for a grand prix, Lawson added: "Oh my God, like 10 times more pressure for this. I would happily get in a Formula 1 car and go into Q3 over doing this."

Racing Bulls shared a photo of Lawson and Ricciardo at the event, along with several videos from the performance. "Racing Bulls giving the people what they want," one fan commented, while another added: "Australasia loves to see it."
"OH MY GOD, I'M TOTALLY CALM AND COLLECTED ABOUT THIS (I’m 110% screaming)," another fan posted.
The United States Grand Prix will take place on 25 October at the Circuit of the Americas.
